_comment: Audio status manifest (DEVELOPMENT_PLAN Step 15, AC-15.3). Every registered audio event must match an entry (exact name, or a prefix ending in *; the longest prefix wins) with status 'final' or 'accepted' + reason. Audited by tools/run_sim.sh presentation. 'optional' entries may be unused (recordings not yet delivered).

ann_*.reason: Voice of the Mountain announcer: synthesized layered whisper voice (ScoreAudio.announcer), always subtitled. Recorded VO is a human asset request; accepted for 1.0.

pu_vo_*.reason: Power-up callouts in the Voice of the Mountain synth voice (Step 15), always subtitled; recorded VO is a human asset request.

perk_jingle_*.note: Original perk jingles arranged as 30-45 s idle pieces (PerkAudio.arrangement, Step 15).

perk_sting_*.note: Original purchase stingers derived from each perk jingle (PerkAudio).

vo_voice.reason: Synthesized speaker voice for quest VO and quips (pitched per speaker), always subtitled; per-line recordings load automatically from content/audio/vo/ when delivered.

vo_voice_radio.reason: Radio-filtered synthesized speaker voice for quest broadcasts, always subtitled; per-line recordings load automatically when delivered.

vo_rec_*.note: Recorded quest VO lines (content/audio/vo/<entry>_<line>.*) when delivered.

snowblind.reason: Easter-egg song 'Snowblind': original motif synthesized in code (QuestAudio). A produced rock/industrial version is a human asset request.
